Advisory Alpha LLC Buys 8,837 Shares of Oracle Corporation $ORCL

Advisory Alpha LLC raised its stake in shares of Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL - Free Report) by 116.2% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 16,444 shares of the enterprise software provider's stock
